name: TRIAGE
title: WAVE1-05: Vision Commands (start, check, critique, respond, agree)

rationale.dependency_depth: Moderate - uses existing vision modules (types, critique, storage) but needs session management
rationale.criteria_count: Multiple: session state, question loading, answer extraction, critique scoring, gate checking

commands_to_implement.description: Create new vision session with questions
Answer questions in session, extract fields, detect conflicts
Run Skeptical PM critique on vision section
Check if vision gate can be unlocked (alignment score check)

dependencies.title: Create command_router.gleam for dispatching JSONL commands
dependencies.note: Command router is needed for JSONL protocol. Can work around by using Glint CLI pattern temporarily.

dependencies.title: Create jsonl_input.gleam for parsing JSONL stdin
dependencies.note: JSONL input parsing needed for AI-native protocol. Can work around by using Glint CLI pattern temporarily.

dependencies.title: JSONL Storage Pattern
dependencies.note: Vision storage already exists using JSONL, may need updates for consistency

dependencies.title: Output Formatting (JSON + next_actions)
dependencies.note: json_output module exists and is used by other commands, should be sufficient

blocking_decision.reasoning: While AI-04 and AI-05 are not complete, we can implement vision commands using the existing Glint CLI pattern (like other commands in intent.gleam). The json_output module already provides structured output. This allows us to ship functionality now and refactor to pure JSONL protocol later when the router is ready.
blocking_decision.implementation_strategy: Follow the pattern of existing commands (validate, quality, etc.) using Glint CLI + json_output for structured responses
